reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Reduce malaria incidence to less than 1/1000 by 2017 - Comoros (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Comoros, Malaria, Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Union of the Comoros (PNLP)This program has the following goals: Réduire l’incidence du paludisme à moins de 1/1000 habitant d’ici 2017, afin de progresser vers son élimination. The objectives of this program are: Build the institutional, technical and managerial capacities of the National Malaria Control Program at all levels in order to consolidate progress made in controlling malaria, with a view to pre-elimination by 2016.. Continue to strengthen the epidemiological and entomological surveillance system and monitoring and evaluation, including active detection of all cases and all foci of transmission by the end of 2016.. Detect all malaria infection cases through high-quality biological diagnosis and treat them properly in accordance with the national treatment policy by 2016.. Protect 100 percent of the at-risk population with effective malaria prevention methods by 2016.. Strengthen the knowledge, attitudes and practices of the whole population with regard to malaria prevention, control and elimination by 2016.
